subject: SOC 2 Type II deliverables, bridge letter, and targeted auth artifacts
content:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@bluecresthealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II deliverables, bridge letter, and targeted auth artifacts

Hi Marta —

Thanks again for taking time today. BlueCrest is on our SOC 2 review list and the auditor has asked us to obtain the latest Type II report (PDF) and a bridge letter that covers any control changes after the report date through the audit window.

In addition to the report, could you confirm whether you can provide the following targeted artifacts (sample extracts rather than full production exports is fine):

- Scoped auth log slices (CloudTrail/identity events) for the audit window: 2025-11-01 to 2026-04-30. We only need representative slices (CSV) for these dates: 2025-11-15, 2026-01-06, and 2026-04-15.
- MFA enforcement and rotation events (enrollment, revocation, device change) for privileged accounts (admins and service owners) during the same window.
- Evidence of the quarterly privileged access recertification performed in Jan 2026 (review spreadsheets or attestation emails).
- KMS key rotation metadata (rotation timestamps and key IDs) for the master keys used for customer-facing workloads.

If you can provide the Type II PDF and a bridge letter upfront, that will unblock the auditor. For the slices/CSV we can receive them via a secure Share (Drive link or SFTP) or as password-protected attachments. I've attached a short checklist to help scope what the auditor expects.

Timeline request: would you be able to share the report and bridge letter by EOD Wednesday (2026-05-13) and the scoped artifacts by Friday (2026-05-15)? If any of the artifacts require a longer lead time, please highlight which ones and an estimated delivery date.

Thanks — really appreciate your help.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Attachment: SOC2_TypeII_Request_Checklist.pdf

-----
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@bluecresthealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: audit@bluecresthealth.com
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 11:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II deliverables, bridge letter, and targeted auth artifacts

Hi Sean,

Thanks for the clear list — we can help. Quick answers up front:

- We will provide the signed SOC 2 Type II report (covering the period 2025-05-01 to 2026-04-30) and a bridge letter that documents changes since the report end date.
- Scoped auth log slices are possible; our security team typically provides CSV extracts. We prefer to deliver via a secure Drive link with limited access.
- MFA events: we can provide enrollment and revocation logs, but rotation metadata for service accounts may require a manual pull (adds 1–2 business days).
- Privileged access recertification evidence: we have an internal attestation log and the PDF of the Jan 2026 reviewer confirmations.
- KMS rotation metadata: available, will confirm key IDs in our export.

We can get the report and bridge letter to you by 2026-05-13 EOD. Scoped extracts: earliest delivery is 2026-05-15 for the auth CSVs; MFA rotation metadata might slip to 2026-05-17 depending on workload.

For the scoped extracts we need an exact list of account IDs or service names to include in the CSV (to avoid leaking unnecessary rows). Could you reply with the minimal scoping parameters (e.g., admin usernames, service-account IDs, or tag values)?

I will place the report and bridge letter in a secure folder and send the link once uploaded.

Regards,
Marta Ruiz
Security Manager, BlueCrest Health
marta.ruiz@bluecresthealth.com

-----
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@bluecresthealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II deliverables, bridge letter, and targeted auth artifacts

Hi Marta — perfect, thank you.

For scoping, please include the following minimal selectors:
- Admin usernames: admin@bluecresthealth.com, ops-admin@bluecresthealth.com
- Service accounts: svc-redwood-ingest (AWS account 842311), svc-analytics (AWS account 842311)
- Tag filter: env:prod and tag:customer-facing

Those selectors should be sufficient for the auditor. If the CSV export has an event-type column, please include only these event names: Authenticate, MFAEnrollment, MFARevoke, AssumeRole, CreateAccessKey, DeleteAccessKey, KMSRotateKey.

We appreciate the proposed dates. Please send the Type II PDF and bridge link when ready. If you hit any blocker, call me directly — 415-555-0198.

Best,
Sean

-----
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: ACTION: BlueCrest deliverables — scoped log extracts and MFA rotation metadata

Laura / Karthik — forwarding thread with BlueCrest (see above). Auditor wants the files by Friday. Can you please coordinate the following ASAP?

- Karthik: take point with infra for pulling the CSV slices for the three dates (2025-11-15, 2026-01-06, 2026-04-15) scoped to the selectors Sean listed. Format should be: timestamp, event_type, username, source_ip, resource, request_id. Save as requested_auth_log_examples.csv.
- Laura: please prepare the privileged access recertification evidence (Jan 2026) — PDF of attestations and the reviewer spreadsheet. Confirm we can share via the secure Drive link Marta will provide.

I'll follow up with Marta if we need clarifications on KMS key IDs. Mark this high priority — auditor will flag any delays.

Thanks,
Sean

[Internal note: HubSpot/BLUECREST record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/BLUECREST — mark as compliance deliverable]
